dish.n: CWA tasty cheese scones with butter
dish.note: Light tasty cheese scones, split warm and buttered, for the fete tea table.
dish.how: Rub 50g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour and 1 tsp salt, stir in 150g grated tasty cheese, then mix in about 300ml cold milk with a butter knife to a soft, sticky dough. Pat out to 3cm thick, cut into 12 rounds, set close together on a tray and brush with milk. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes until risen and golden, and serve warm with butter.

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour and salt, then stir in the cheese.
Mix in the milk to a soft dough, pat out and cut into 12 rounds.
Set on a tray, brush with milk and bake at 220C until risen and golden.

dish.make_ahead: Bake on the day; they are best warm
